fullDescription: Implements the add secondary membership view based on reference image 1777781280362-0m1yd6qajlo.jpeg. The screen shows the primary member name and status, a single-step membership data sidebar, personal data fields with photo placeholder, contact inputs with send-code actions and decline checkboxes, address inputs with a same-as-primary option, and footer actions for going home, saving changes, returning to the previous step, or adding the member.

Reusable membership-area header that renders the dark brand bar, logo, store selector, country selector, and language selector used by membership-focused views. It is intended for streamlined operational screens that need the simplified two-row header instead of the main ecommerce site navigation, including the secondary membership registration form and other membership workflow views.

Reusable action tile for membership workflows with a circular icon, bold title, and active or inactive visual state. It can be used on landing screens to present options such as creating a membership, reviewing pending processes, or similar membership service actions.

shortDescription: Membership search and action landing screen.
fullDescription: Implements the membership landing view based on reference image 1777781280776-hz85g27aqjj.jpeg. The screen uses the reusable membership dashboard header and action tiles, then presents a search section for locating an existing member by name, phone, email, or membership ID before starting a new membership process.

shortDescription: Membership verification modal for confirming contacts.
fullDescription: Reusable verification dialog for membership workflows that lists primary and secondary member contacts, shows verified and pending states, renders four code entry boxes with a resend action for pending members, and provides a final Done action. It supports rows with or without a displayed member name and can be reused anywhere a membership contact confirmation step is needed, including the view based on reference image 1777781279681-hbeprvw275k.jpeg.

Implements the membership verification view using the reusable membership verification dialog centered over a dimmed application background. The screen presents a compact confirmation modal with the verify memberships heading, explanatory copy, verified and pending member rows, code input boxes, resend links, and a Done button for finishing the confirmation flow shown in reference image 1777781279681-hbeprvw275k.jpeg.
